name: Brazos Cubing Fall 2023
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)

Note: This competition takes place on a Sunday.
# **NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS ALLOWED IN THE VENUE**

- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrazosCubingFall2023#30242-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrazosCubingFall2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

To learn more about Cubing in the US South, visit www.southerncubing.com.
